title: RL-VLA$^3$: A Flexible and Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for VLA Training
abstract: arXiv:2602.05765v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical paradigm for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, enabling embodied agents to adapt and improve through environmental interaction. However, existing RL frameworks for VLAs inherit synchronous design principles from traditional LLM training, treating entire rollouts as indivisible units and alternating strictly between data collection and policy optimization. This fundamentally mismatches the unique characteristics of VLA training, as physical simulators introduce highly variable, resource-intensive latencies. To address this, we introduce RL-VLA$^3$, a fully asynchronous distributed RL framework that enables fine-grained asynchronous interaction between simulation, inference, and training components through dynamic batching schedulers and flexible environment sharding strategies. translated_title: RL-VLA$^3$：一个用于VLA训练的灵活异步强化学习框架
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型后训练的关键范式，使具身智能体能够通过环境交互进行适应和改进。然而，现有的VLA强化学习框架沿用了传统大语言模型（LLM）训练的同步设计原则，将整个轨迹（rollout）视为不可分割的单元，并在数据收集和策略优化之间严格交替进行。这与VLA训练的独特特性存在根本上的不匹配，因为物理模拟器会引入高度可变且资源密集型的延迟。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了RL-VLA$^3$，这是一个完全异步的分布式强化学习框架，通过动态批处理调度器和灵活的环境分片策略，实现了模拟、推理和训练组件之间的细粒度异步交互。大量实验在多种模拟后端、VLA架构和RL算法上验证了……
tldr: RL-VLA$^3$是一个完全异步的分布式强化学习框架，通过动态批处理调度器和灵活的环境分片策略，解决了现有同步RL框架与VLA训练中模拟器延迟高且可变的特性不匹配的问题，实现了模拟、推理和训练组件间的细粒度异步交互。
